name: Hacker Reveal
description: Random hex characters resolve into the real text.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text,n=Math.round(t.length*env.time),cs="0123456789ABCDEF",o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charAt(i); if(i<n||c===" "){ o+=c; } else { var r=(AM.simplexNoise(i*3.3+env.absTime*p.speed, p.seed)+1)/2; o+=cs.charAt(Math.floor(r*cs.length)%cs.length); } } el.text=o; return el; }
